title: Abdominal Aortic Aneurysm: Screening: men aged 65 to 75 years who have ever smoked

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends 1-time screening for abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) with ultrasonography in men aged 65 to 75 years who have ever smoked.

action: One-time abdominal aortic aneurysm screening with ultrasonography

all.note: Relies on structured smoking-history (ever smoker) data being recorded

denominator.quote: men aged 65 to 75 years who have ever smoked

numerator.quote: 1-time screening for abdominal aortic aneurysm (AAA) with ultrasonography

derived.window: 1-time screening means any screening since the patient became eligible at 65; the oldest eligible patient (75 at end of MY) turned 65 during MY-10, so a window starting {MY-10}-01-01 captures any screening done since age 65
